decisions.reason: For equal-mass compounds ordered by total energy on the open convex chart R², A1–A7 and S1–S3 hold: sectors are energy half-spaces with constant zero slope, strict energy successors and connected boundary lines. The strictly increasing function S(u,v)=u³ represents single-state comparisons, but the equivalent compounds (1/2)J(0,0)+(1/2)J(2,0) and J(1,0) have candidate entropy sums 4 and 1. The original inference from single-state representation to compound representation is therefore false. Repair defines the full compound iff required of an additive entropy density before applying the weight formulas; it leaves existence to the later representation theorem.
